connect.question: How can I connect with my neighbors?

contribute.question: What economic value can I bring to my community?
contribute.narrative: Personal-agent guidance: in an AI economic transition, the work/education/communications complement is the lever — pursue value at the intersection of your strengths and your community's gaps.

advocate.question: How can I effectively advocate for change?
advocate.narrative: Approach: pair the strongest agency/governance score (gives you the institutional surface to operate within) with the highest-leverage gap (gives you the change to push for).
